Sandbox_ZSpeed_tooltip: Project Nightfall uses this engine-safe base tier and controls actual zombie speed through Project M.O.R.T.I.S.
Sandbox_ZSprinterPercentage_tooltip: Vanilla random sprinters are disabled. Only Nightfall Ferals may sprint, using type-specific decision rules and UV reserve.
Sandbox_ActiveOnly_tooltip: Project Nightfall controls day, night, sunlight, artificial-UV, Feral, and Smart Feral locomotion states.
Sandbox_DisableFakeDead_tooltip: Vanilla fake-dead spawning is disabled so Project Nightfall exclusively owns sunlight hibernation, disturbance, and rising.
Sandbox_RallyGroupSize_help: Vanilla idle rally groups are disabled. Nightfall hordes may form only through a Smart Feral leader and Nightfall's bounded recruitment system.
Sandbox_RallyGroupSizeVariance_help: Vanilla rally-group variance has no effect because Project Nightfall forces vanilla rally-group size to zero.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_FeralSprintUVPe: At the default 18 points per game minute, 90 usable reserve points provide five in-game minutes of sprinting.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_SmartFeralRawCo: Set to 0 to disable Smart Ferals. Tier 1 permits only the highest cognition setting; higher values broaden eligibility.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_EnableSmartFera: Vanilla rally groups remain disabled. Only Smart Ferals recruit bounded local groups of Nightfall Ferals.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_EnableAlphaFera: A successful Smart Feral creation may instead become an Alpha. Disabling this prevents new Alphas without changing existing ones.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_AlphaReplacemen: Raw probability from 0 to 1, rolled only after a zombie successfully qualifies for Smart Feral creation. The default 0.001 is 0.1 percent.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_EnableSmartFera: Smart Ferals under severe combat pressure may abandon their Alpha. They cannot immediately defect to a living rival Alpha.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_SmartFeralDeser: Higher values require more severe health, follower-loss, isolation, and combat pressure before desertion is possible.
Hard maximum probability for a desertion roll after the pressure threshold is met.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_EnableAlphaTerr: Alphas with enough linked Smart Ferals may claim territory only after finding a currently safe loaded underground den.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_AlphaDenSearchR: Searches only loaded nearby squares. Increasing this raises settlement opportunities and bounded scan cost.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_DenUnsafeNatura: Active dens at or above this natural UV exposure are disbanded and loaded Smart Ferals physically seek new shelter.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_EnableDenLightS: Applies only around established dens. Roaming Smart Ferals do not generically destroy ordinary lights.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_IndependentSuic: Rare roll for a regular zombie or normal Feral already exposed to active artificial UV. Unsupported or inactive fixtures are never targeted.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_EnableFerals_to: Disable for UV damage, sunlight hibernation and regular-zombie nighttime rises without Ferals or Smart Ferals.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_RequireStarvati: A zombie must completely deplete its hunger stores, then remain continuously starved for the configured duration. Eating resets the starvation timer.
Sandbox_ProjectNightfall_EnableSunKnockd: When enabled, sunlight knocks zombies down at the natural-UV health floor. They hibernate until the nighttime rise event.
